svg.title: GEMM tile-tuning A/B grids, M5 Pro
svg.text: GEMM tile tuning — throughput ratio to production
Blue = variant faster than production, red = slower, gray = parity. Cell = ratio; empty = skipped or not run.
bf16 tiles before the cooperative-destination kernel (2026-08-30)
Ratio to the then-production kernel; production sat at 7–10 TFLOP/s, so the cooperative tiles are not here yet.
bf16 tiles after the cooperative kernel landed (2026-08-30)
Ratio to the landed production path; ~1.0 means the selection table already picks the winner.
TN / NT / accumulate and NN grid swizzle (2026-08-30)
Ratio to the landed production path. tn_512x768_k4096 appears twice in the file; the later measurement is shown (they differ by up to 0.13).
Tied LM head as NT, tile sweep (2026-09-30)
Ratio of throughput to production. The file has two runs; where a cell is in both, the second is shown (differences up to 0.12). Decision: keep the NN head.
Exact-f32 with a register accumulator, and the bf16 rig re-run (2026-09-30) — bf16 rig
Bar set before the run: ≥ 1.3× over production.
Exact-f32 with a register accumulator, and the bf16 rig re-run (2026-09-30) — exact f32
Bar set before the run: ≥ 1.3× over production.
